home.title: Il Paradiso — Seafood and Italian Restaurant in Hammamet, near the Medina
home.description: Fresh fish and seafood, Italian pasta. In Hammamet, a few minutes' walk from the medina and the fort. 4.4/5 on Google, 95 reviews.

hero.tagline: Fresh fish and Italian pasta, steps from the medina.
hero.distance: A few minutes' walk from the medina and the fort of Hammamet

laMaison.title: The house
laMaison.p1: Italian cooking, facing the sea. Grilled sea bass, clams, seafood, kept simple with fresh produce.
laMaison.p2: The traditional pizza oven sits alongside the catch of the day. Here, the menu leans toward pasta and fish.
laMaison.p3: Outdoor terrace for eating al fresco, a few minutes' walk from the medina and the fort of Hammamet.

signatures.title: The signatures
signatures.intro: Four dishes, the ones guests mention most often.

loupGrille.name: Grilled sea bass
loupGrille.description: Whole grilled sea bass, served with a wedge of lemon and a drizzle of olive oil.

vongole.name: Spaghetti alle vongole
vongole.description: Spaghetti with clams, garlic and parsley, cooked al dente.

fruttiDiMare.name: Spaghetti ai frutti di mare
fruttiDiMare.description: Spaghetti with seafood, light tomato sauce, shellfish and squid.

frittura.name: Frittura mista di mare
frittura.description: Small mixed fry of fish and squid, served hot, to share or not.
